title: Last Voyage of the Harpy Express - Fan made
description: A Fan made server of RAT's Harpy Express modpack
body:
A Fan made server of Last Voyage of the Harpy Express.

## Playing
To start the game there must be 6+ players onboard the train, once there is 6+ players the game will start in 30 seconds

## What is TLVotHE (The Last Voyage of the Harpy Express)
TLVotHE Is a train murder mystery game, there are passengers, killers and vigilantes.
### Passengers
- Survive the round 
- You need to do tasks to refill your energy bar
- If your energy bar is low you start to see players having some items that normally killers have and you don't see any bodies anymore
- You can pick up guns
### Killers
- Murder everyone onboard the train
- You have limited time
- Purchase useful items from the shop with coins
- Get coins either 5 coin per 10 seconds or 100 coin per kill
- You can not pick up a gun
### Vigilantes
- You get a gun
- Kill killers with gun
- If you kill passenger you drop your gun

## What is the Game Master?
As a Game Master you will be able to host Loose Ends and Discovery. You will get OP but you are ONLY allowed to use it to host the special gamemodes. You will also need to be supporter of Doctor4t 

abuse powers = ban
